full.description: This is a photomicrograph of tissue showing chronic inflammatory granulation tissue and foreign body giant cells surrounding cholesterol clefts with pink keratinous material and focal calcification. The histologic features are characteristic of an epidermal cyst or a ruptured cyst wall with a foreign body granulomatous reaction to cholesterol and keratin. The section demonstrates laminated keratinous debris, clefts left by dissolved cholesterol crystals, and surrounding inflammation.

blind.description: This is a photomicrograph of a skin or dermal lesion. The image shows tumor islands and lobules located within the dermis, composed of outer basophilic cells and inner shadow cells. Areas of calcification are also present within the tumor. These characteristic microscopic features strongly suggest calcifying epithelioma of Malherbe, also known as a pilomatricoma.

random.description: This is a photomicrograph of an artery wall, likely showing an atherosclerotic plaque with dystrophic calcification and cholesterol clefts. The section demonstrates intimal thickening, fibrous tissue, and focal basophilic deposits of calcium. The arterial media shows structural changes characteristic of chronic atherosclerosis.
